tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rang gis rang la bskul ba keng shu ka'i 'dab ma rlung bskyod ces bya ba bzhugs so//

/zhing khams rgya mtshor bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// nus ldan thugs rje'i mnga' dpung bskyed mdzod la// srid gsum 'khor bar gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams// log pa'i lam la nam yang mi gtong gsol// thog med dus nas srid mtshor bying bzhin pa// ma rig dbang gis yang 'khor las la 'bad// rang las rang la smin pa ma shes nas// le lan gzhan la bsgo ba snying re rje// rnyed dka'i dal 'byor yid bzhin rin po che// mi dge'i las la rje ngan g.yog bzhin bskol// tshe gcig don la skye gtan 'dun ma bshol// rang mgo rang gis bskor ba ma shes ang*// mi rtag 'chi ba glo bur nyid du yong*// cis kyang mi khog nam mkha'i thog dang 'dra// nye 'gyang ma gtogs sdom rgyas sgug pa bzhin| |yong nges 'chi ba yin pas ci phan ang*// gro nas sran gsum sa bon 'thor ba bzhin// 'khrul 'phyug med nges las kyi 'bras bu ste// rang gzhan gnyis phung las ngan tshabs po che// 'di 'dra bsags la kye ma ci phan ang*// rang nyid pham gyis dogs pa'i zon skyor dang*// gzhan rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i thabs rtsol gyis// bslu ham ngan gra bsgrigs nas dus 'debs byed// rang gis rang nyid thar med btson rar 'dzud// da lta bzhi bcu kha ral snyigs ma'i dus// tshe yi tshad ni ji tsam ring na yang*// lo brgya 'tsho ba'i mi ni nyin skar tsam// yud tsam 'di la dge bcu mi sgrub ang*// sde byus nye 'brel g.yog 'khor dang gzhan don// rlabs chen sgrub pa'i skyes bu stobs ldan dang*// kha drag shes bshes mi yi khyu mchog yang*// grogs med gcer bu gcig pur 'gro ba mthong*// skad cig mtshams sbyor ngan pa'i rkyen byas shing*// zhe sdang dbang gis mi min gzugs bzung nas// mas mgal tham tham lag na mtshon cha bzung*/ /khrag mtsho'i nang na 'gul sdod snying re rje// rang byas sngon song rnam dkar dge ba med// rjes su 'brang ba'i legs smon mthu yis dman/

/shul na brtse sems ldan pa'i rogs ram med// mgon grogs dang bral da lta skyo bar snang*// srid pa 'di na drag zhan bar ma dang*// ban skye ngan pa'i spyod tshul ma legs pa/ /'di 'dra mthong gin kho bo snying rlung ldang*/ /kha tsam ma yin don la yi mug skyes/ /kho bo'i yab mes grub thob kho na ste// rgyal bas lung bstan 'brel tshad don dang ldan/ /'khrul ba mi mnga' mu tig rtsar bzhin brgyud/ /brtse ldan thugs rje can rnams bdag la dgongs// bdag gis dal 'byor don yod bya ba'i phyir| |dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi bstan la zhugs// thos bsam sgom la 'bad 'bung mi bgyid par// gzhan phan bgyid blo'i rang nyid 'ching bar mngon// dpe med bstan pa'i khur chen 'degs blo yis/ /'dus pa'i dbus su drang ba'i skad gsang yang*/ /sgyu ma'i grong la skyes bu chags pa bzhin// chos brgyad zhags pas rang nyid bcing ba 'dra// so so'i yul nas rang rang pha ma dang*// gnyen dang mdza' bshes g.yog 'khor kun bor nas// phyogs phyogs yul nas 'dus pa'i zhen log kyang*// chags sdang ma spangs nga khyod dregs pas myos// rang la nye bar 'khor ba thams cad la'ang*// drag zhan ma bgyis nye bar snying snyoms na// 'di yi bzang ngan drag zhan ngo mi shes// rgyus yod zer nas ro bzhin 'dor la nye// bzang ngan ye nas drang por thig bzhin bsrang*// drag zhan bar ma ban skye su la yang*// rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin g.yo med dgos smras na// blor mi shong zhing khog pa'i gcong du song*// gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin du// rgyu 'di las ni 'bras bu 'di 'dra zhes// ma 'dres so sor phyes nas bshad pa na// kha thag ring zhes tshur la gshe bar nye// tshur la bsdus na nyin zhag phrugs re'i khongs// spyan ras gzigs dang bla ma'i sku tsam la// sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i nyams len mdzod// 'di la 'bub pa med do byas pa na/

/ha cang bsdus zhes g.yel chung byed pa snang*// ji ltar smras pa'i tshig ni chu sgra bzhin// don du yid la bab pa gcig kyang med// chos sbyin mkhan la zhus so drin bgrang byed| |bskal brgyar bdag 'dras gzhan don ji ltar bgyid// da lta snyigs ma'i dus kyi bla ma dang*// sde dpon mchod yon grwa pa sbyin bdag rnams// so sor gcig snying gcig la mi gtod de// zur 'grog ngang la dam tshig rdo bzhin bskyur// 'jig rten dpe tshul 'di yang bden par snang*// bshes gnyen dam pa me dang 'dra zhes gleng*// ring nas mos gus byas na byin rlabs 'jug /ha cang nye na mi dge 'phral la gsog /yul la bdag bzung nye 'brel g.yog 'khor sogs// tshangs pa lta bu'i mnga' thang longs spyod can// 'dod yon srid pa'i 'ching byed ltar gzigs nas// bcom ldan ser skya'i gnas nas mkha' la gshegs// bdag kyang 'khor ba'i chos dang 'jig rten la// zhen tshul dor nas bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten| |phyin ci ma log dam chos snying nas bgyid// so thar byang sems mig 'bras bzhin du srung*// dam chos lnga la nan tan gnad du bsnun// dkon mchog gsum ni spyi bor rtag tu 'dzin| |bdag gi sngon tshe'i legs smon ci 'dra ang*// pad+ma 'byung gnas dharma rā dza yis// kho bo bstan 'dzin 'gro phan bgyid pa la// bdud bzhi'i dbang du nam yang ma gtong zhig /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// gang shar skyong zhing rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim// pha yul spangs nas chags zhen la la yal// 'dzin med ngang nas rang gzhan don gnyis sgrub// ces pa mkhar rtser gu ru rdo rje pha bu'i 'chi rkyen mtshams sbyor dang*/ skyo gnas kyis rkyen byas/ rang lo bco brgyad kyi steng hor zla lnga pa'i tshes brgyad la rang gis rang la smras pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
